notes:
A compound of {施|し} (to perform, to administer) and ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (technique, art). Used broadly for both medical procedures and therapeutic treatments.

USAGE:
While ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ specifically means surgery (cutting), {施術|しじゅつ} has a wider scope that includes non-surgical treatments such as chiropractic, acupuncture, massage, and cosmetic procedures. It is the standard term used by clinics, salons, and therapists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {施術|しじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to receive a treatment/procedure
- {施術|しじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ — to perform a procedure
- {施術|しじゅつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ — after the procedure
- {施術|しじゅつ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ — treatment time/duration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ — surgery; specifically invasive surgical operations
- ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ — treatment; broader term for medical care and healing
- ⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧ — medical treatment; often for emergency or first-aid measures
